text:
Priya: heads-up
urora (hw partner) asked for a marketplace private offer that combines committed spend + a co-sell hardware credit. want to avoid extra billing ops. who's on this? :thinking_face:
Ben: I can own the pricing table. proposal thought: make the hw credit a redeemable top-up in customer's billing wallet (not a manual invoice credit). reduces reconciliation headaches.
Olga: top-up wallet sounds good but need finance sign-off on revenue deferral. also want a minimum commitment to qualify.
Diego: SI perspective - keep the acceptance flow simple for partners. marketplace private-offer needs a clear SKU so SIs can quote confidently. also request a short co-sell playbook included in the offer description.
Ben: draft tiers (neutralized to be conservative):
```
Platinum: commit >= $750k/year -> 32% platform discount + $150k hw wallet top-up; renewal bonus: 5% uplift if renewed 12m
Gold: commit $300k-$749k -> 20% discount + $50k hw wallet top-up; renewal bonus: 3%
Silver: commit $100k-$299k -> 12% discount + $12k hw wallet top-up
Activation floor: $90k ARR required to turn offer live
Wallet expiry: 18 months from issuance
```
Priya: two notes: (1) 18 months wallet expiry ok, but make a 6mo ramp window where discount steps up after usage gates; (2) need a clawback for hw wallet if they churn within 120 days.
Olga: finance: prefer invoice credit for accounting simplicity but can accept wallet if we treat wallet as deferred revenue liability. Activation floor $90k is fine. Clawback: prorated repayment within 120 days, or offset against remaining wallet balance.
Diego: for SI quoting, include language: "marketplace SKU: redwood.marketplace:aurora-commit-v1" and a short alt SKU for managed services. also request a co-sell email template.
Priya: product/ops note: marketplace private-offer API needs fields: offer_label, commit_term_months, commit_amount_usd, discount_pct, hw_wallet_amount_usd, wallet_expiry_days, renewal_bonus_pct, activation_floor_usd, clawback_window_days, si_playbook_url. I'll create a spec for eng-catalog.
Ben: can we do renewal incentives as an on-invoice percentage credit (applied after renewal billing) instead of altering base discount? simpler for downstream billing.
Olga: yep, renewal bonus as post-renewal invoice credit is easier. document as a separate line item.
Priya: launch cadence idea: 1) Partner + SI kickoff (T-28) 2) Catalog spec + finance sign-off (T-21) 3) Pilot private-offer with Aurora + 1 SI customer (T-14) 4) Marketplace listing + joint launch email (T) 5) Co-sell webinar + metrics review (T+30).
Diego: suggest pilot at T-10 to compress timeline; SIs prefer less waiting.
Ben: engineering asks: need a way to tag offers so they appear in partner-restricted listing and for billing to consume wallet credits automatically. tagging fields: partner_id, restricted_listing=true.
Priya: legal flags?
Diego: not legal but ops: need a clear statement on marketing rights and logo usage in the offer description. Aurora asked for a joint blog mention.
Olga: legal will want DPA + mutual PR approval. also require a clause: "wallet credits void on evidence of fraud or misuse". simple and standard.
Priya: next steps: Ben to finalize tier math and post to this thread; Olga to validate accounting treatment and draft the invoice-credit vs wallet flow; Diego to draft SI playbook + email templates; I'll assemble the catalog spec and schedule the kickoff.
launch-coordinator: calendar event "Aurora private-offer kickoff" scheduled for T-28; invites sent to partnerships, finance, legal, eng-catalog, eng-billing, SI leads.
Ben: posting tier spreadsheet now, will link after upload.
Olga: filing accounting notexpect response by EOD tomorrow.
Diego: starting SI playbook draft. tagging @SI-team for early review.
Priya: great work team. i'll collate decisions and push an ADO card with acceptance criteria. thanks all :sparkles:
